summary: Red Hat supports only plugins remaining in ansible-core and collections hosted on Automation Hub; nothing else is supported. Subscribers find resources on the Customer Portal.
questions: Does Red Hat support community.general modules?
Which Ansible collections come with Red Hat support?

answer_card.title: What Red Hat supports
answer_card.answer_md:
Red Hat supports **only**:
- plugins that remain in `ansible-core`
- collections hosted on Automation Hub

No other plugins or collections are supported. Subscribers can find resources on the Red Hat Customer Portal.
